standards.title: Corrections
standards.text: Material errors are corrected in the story and listed on this page with the date and relevant context.

standards.title: Clarifications
standards.text: Language may be clarified when additional context improves accuracy without changing the underlying reporting.

standards.title: Updates
standards.text: Developing stories carry clear update notes when new reporting materially changes the record.

standards.title: Transparency
standards.text: Tysons Times distinguishes corrections from routine copy edits and preserves a visible record of substantive changes.
